'''Droidnostics''' were a diagnostics system used for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] such as [[R2-D4]]. The [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency employed droidnostics at [[Tomorrowland Starport|their spaceport's]] [[Droidnostics Center]].<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>
